description: The bar chart titled 'Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks' visually compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (represented by blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (represented by orange bars)—across nine distinct datasets and metrics listed along the horizontal axis, labeled 'Dataset and Metrics', which includes GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis is labeled 'Score (%)' and employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 10 percentage points. For each dataset, two adjacent bars are displayed side-by-side, with the blue bar corresponding to LLaMA-3-8B-it and the orange bar to Ours (Iterative RLHF). On GSM-8K, both models achieve scores of approximately 80%. On MMLU, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores 70% while Ours scores 65%. On HumanEval, Ours scores 70% compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it’s 60%. On TruthfulQA, Ours scores 65% while LLaMA-3-8B-it scores 45%. On ARC and MBPP, both models score 60%. On LC AlpacaEval-2, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores approximately 25% while Ours scores 30%. On MT-Bench (×5), LLaMA-3-8B-it scores approximately 40% while Ours scores 42%. On Chat-Arena-Hard, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores approximately 22% while Ours scores approximately 30%. The bars are arranged in the order of the datasets listed on the x-axis, with no explicit sorting, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any individual bar.
caption_used: The bar chart titled 'Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks' compares the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), across nine datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis is labeled 'Dataset and Metrics,' with categories including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents 'Score (%)' on a linear scale from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10%. Both models perform similarly on GSM-8K, achieving scores of approximately 80%. On MMLU, LLaMA-3-8B-it slightly outperforms Ours (Iterative RLHF) with a score of 70% compared to 65%. For HumanEval, Ours (Iterative RLHF) shows a notable improvement, scoring 70% compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it's 60%. TruthfulQA demonstrates a consistent upward trend for both models, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) reaching 65% and LLaMA-3-8B-it trailing at 45%. ARC and MBPP show identical performance for both models at 60%. LC AlpacaEval-2 and MT-Bench (×5) exhibit modest scores, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) slightly outperforming LLaMA-3-8B-it. Chat-Arena-Hard shows the lowest scores, with both models performing below 30%. Overall, Ours (Iterative RLHF) consistently outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it across most benchmarks, particularly in HumanEval and TruthfulQA, demonstrating its superior generalization capabilities.
